CustomObject.description: THE RUN LEASE. One pass at a time per opportunity, ordered by when the conversation happened. R5, accepted with design's correction at the hundred-tenth stamp and ordered by the hundred-nineteenth as a PROCESS PREREQUISITE rather than hygiene: Process reads written state, so a Process pass racing a People pass reads a half-written map. TWO ROW KINDS, BOTH KEYED. A Holder row keyed HOLD|opportunity is unique, so exactly one pass holds a deal and the INDEX guarantees it rather than a read that could race. A Waiting row keyed WAIT|opportunity|source enrolls a pass that arrived while the deal was held. THE DRAIN TAKES THE EARLIEST EVIDENCE-OCCURRED SOURCE, never the earliest arrival: a lease serializes, the law orders, and a late-delivered older call read after a newer one would read history backwards. IT IS A LOCK AND NEVER EVIDENCE, which is why a released row is deleted; the run receipt carries the history.
